candidate_grid_rule: Under the separately frozen repository-score symmetry model, reject designs whose exact 2^R score-sign space cannot attain Holm-corrected alpha before evaluating power.

claims.broader_external_validity: requires prospectively justified repository/task sampling frame and interaction precision; cannot be inferred from nested executions
claims.primary_bounded_migration: requires the same repository-score symmetry sign-flip model plus Holm production test, frozen effect thresholds, binding conjunction, and lower 95% power bound >=0.80
claims.repository_interactions: separately powered condition-by-repository contrasts with multiple independent repositories; primary N does not imply this claim
claims.task_class_interactions: separately powered condition-by-task-class contrasts with Holm correction

finite_cluster_eligibility.test: exact two-sided whole-repository score sign flip under independent-cluster/joint-symmetry assumption
finite_cluster_eligibility.warning: This is not task-template randomization inference. Increasing pair count or sign-flip draws cannot improve 2^R resolution, and eligibility is void unless the symmetry assumption is prospectively justified.

independence_guard: LOW/HIGH executions and templates inside a repository are never counted as independent repository observations.
reason: Only synthetic assumption regimes exist; legitimate outcome-blind nuisance bounds and frozen repositories/tasks do not.
selection_rule: After outcome-blind calibration and prospective justification of the repository independence/joint-symmetry assumption, among structurally eligible designs select the smallest design whose lower Wilson 95% bound is >=0.80 for the production-aligned primary conjunction in every defensible regime. Otherwise FINAL_N_NOT_YET_FREEZABLE.
